title: The Wyrm Graveyard
text: Old wyrms come to die in this valley of great bones, with ribs like cathedral vaults and skulls like houses. One of them has not quite finished. Its breath is a slow rasp. Its eye is open, and it is looking at you.

options.label: The most blooded gives it a clean end, as a warrior would want.

outcomes.text: It lets them. Its last breath is warm, and it leaves a gift.

options.label: Take bones from the dead ones and leave the dying one in peace.

outcomes.text: It watches you work, very slowly.

options.label: The wisest listens to what it has to say before it falls silent for good.

outcomes.text: It talks for an hour about a world before the rift. Nobody sleeps well after.
